document.title: 222Emails Master Operating Context
document.naming_rule: No underscores in new canonical 222Emails context filenames.

brand.logo: Official V3 logo from connected Google Drive

positioning.master_line: 222Emails installs practical client-return systems that help appointment-led businesses bring past clients back, refill quieter weeks and reduce manual chasing through the right combination of email, SMS and, where appropriate, WhatsApp.
positioning.ecommerce_status: Retained capability and historical/adjacent proof, not current lead positioning.

proof.appointment_led_case_library: not yet deep/proven in reviewed sources
rules: Never fabricate results, clients, testimonials, urgency, scarcity or guarantees.
Never present adjacent ecommerce/campaign evidence as appointment-led revenue proof.
Label demo, pilot and illustrative work clearly.

outreach.calls: Selective for high-value/high-intent; asynchronous routes remain important.
